verses.1: After that, I heard a loud voice from many people in the heavens, saying: “Hallelujah! Salvation, glory, and power belong to our God.”
verses.2: Because his judgments were true and just. He punished the greatest prostitute who had brought destruction upon his land through her actions. He also punished the blood of his slaves at her hands.
verses.3: And secondly, they said: “Hell’s fire.” And her smoke rises up to the heavens of eternity.
verses.4: And the older men fell down, along with forty-four animals. They also worshipped the god who sat on the throne, saying, “Amén, Alléluia.”
verses.5: And a voice came from the throne, saying: “Praise the God of our Lord, all those who are His servants, and all those who fear Him, both the small and the great.”
verses.6: And I heard the voices of many people, as well as the voices of many waters. It was also the voices of strong men who said, “Hallelujah! The Lord has reigned; the God has ruled, and He is all-powerful.”
verses.7: Let us rejoice and be glad, and give him glory, for the marriage of the ram has taken place, and his wife has prepared herself.
verses.8: And she was given a beautiful, pure, and clean robe to wear. For the robe symbolizes the rights of the saints.
verses.9: And he said to me, “Write down these words: Those who are called to share in the feast of the wedding of the lamb are truly blessed.” And he also said to me, “These words are indeed true words of God.”
verses.10: And I fell before his feet, to worship him. He said to me, “Do not be my companion; I am only a follower of your brothers who bear witness to Jesus. Worship God instead. For the testimony of Jesus is the breath of prophecy.”
verses.11: And I saw that the sky was rising. I also saw a white horse. And there was a man sitting on it, who was called “the True One”. He judged and fought with justice.
verses.12: But his eyes were filled with fire; there were also many wounds on his head. His name was written on them, and no one knew who he was except for him himself.
verses.13: And his robe was covered with blood; also, the Name of God was called by the Word of God.
verses.14: And the armies in heaven followed him on white horses, wearing white robes.
verses.15: And from his mouth, bitter poison is released, so that it can destroy all nations. He also controls the flow of the wine of wrath, which comes from the God of all things.
verses.16: And there are names written on his thigh and on his buttocks as well. “King of kings, and Lord of lords.”
verses.17: And I saw one angel often in the sky. He cried out with a loud voice to all the birds that were flying in the mid-air. “Let us eat of the great meal that God has prepared for us.”
verses.18: So that you could eat the flesh of kings, and the flesh of thousands of others, and the flesh of strong men, and the flesh of horses, and the flesh of those who sat upon them. And also the flesh of all free people, as well as of slaves, both young and old.
verses.19: And we saw that the monsters, along with the kings of the land and their armies, were all working together to wage war. They did this while sitting on their horses, along with their armies.
verses.20: And he perceived the monster as well as the false prophet who had made those signs before him. In those signs, those who were taking the mark of the monster and those who worshipped its image were deceived. The two of them were then thrown into the lake of fire that burned eternally.
verses.21: And the rest also died in the chariot, as they sat on the horses that came out of their mouths. All of their bodies were consumed by the flesh from which they originated.
